text: Jeannette Walls' The Glass Castle was challenged in 2012, when parents raised concerns about child neglect, alcoholism, abuse and sexual activity among adolescents. A school board reconsideration committee recommended removal, but the Traverse City Board of Education voted to retain the book. A parent also complained to the Marshfield (Wisconsin) School Board about vulgar language and explicit situational content, prompting a formal request to remove it from the curriculum; a committee unanimously recommended retaining it.
meta_description: The Glass Castle by Jeannette Walls: challenged in 2012 in Traverse City; retained after committee review, as was a Marshfield, Wisconsin request.
